# Canva
> Canva is a visual design platform for creating presentations, social posts, videos, documents, websites, and print-ready assets.

Canva combines template-based design, AI-powered creation tools, brand management, collaboration, and publishing workflows for individuals, teams, educators, nonprofits, and enterprises.

## Product Overview
- [Canva home](https://www.canva.com/): Main entry point for Canva’s design platform, templates, and creative tools.
- [Visual Suite](https://www.canva.com/visual-suite/): Overview of Canva’s unified workspace for docs, presentations, whiteboards, and more.
- [Templates](https://www.canva.com/templates/): Browse reusable templates for presentations, social media, marketing, and print.
- [Features](https://www.canva.com/features/): Product capabilities including editing, collaboration, publishing, and brand tools.
- [Apps marketplace](https://www.canva.com/apps/): Discover integrations and apps that extend Canva’s design workflows.
- [Plans and pricing](https://www.canva.com/pricing/): Compare Free, Pro, Teams, Enterprise, Education, and Nonprofit offerings.

## Core Design Tools
- [Docs](https://www.canva.com/docs/): Create collaborative documents with design, media, and presentation capabilities.
- [Whiteboards](https://www.canva.com/whiteboards/): Infinite collaborative whiteboards for brainstorming, planning, and workshops.
- [Presentations](https://www.canva.com/presentations/): Build slide decks with templates, animations, and presenter tools.
- [Video editor](https://www.canva.com/video-editor/): Edit videos with templates, transitions, audio, and publishing tools.
- [Photo editor](https://www.canva.com/photo-editor/): Edit images with filters, background removal, retouching, and effects.
- [Website builder](https://www.canva.com/websites/): Design and publish simple websites and landing pages from templates.
- [Print](https://www.canva.com/print/): Order printed designs including cards, flyers, posters, and branded materials.

## AI and Creative Assistance
- [Magic Studio](https://www.canva.com/magic-studio/): Canva’s AI toolkit for generating, editing, summarizing, and transforming content.
- [Magic Design](https://www.canva.com/magic-design/): Generate design concepts from prompts or uploaded media.
- [Magic Write](https://www.canva.com/magic-write/): AI writing assistant for drafting, rewriting, and summarizing text.
- [Text to Image](https://www.canva.com/features/ai-image-generator/): Generate images from text prompts for creative projects.
- [Background Remover](https://www.canva.com/features/background-remover/): Remove image backgrounds automatically for cleaner compositions.
- [Translate](https://www.canva.com/features/translate/): Translate designs and text content into multiple languages.

## Brand and Team Collaboration
- [Brand Hub](https://www.canva.com/brand/): Manage logos, colors, fonts, and brand assets across teams.
- [Canva Teams](https://www.canva.com/canva-teams/): Collaboration features for shared design workflows and approvals.
- [Enterprise](https://www.canva.com/enterprise/): Security, governance, admin, and scale features for large organizations.
- [Brand templates](https://www.canva.com/features/brand-templates/): Create reusable templates that keep team output on-brand.
- [Content Planner](https://www.canva.com/features/content-planner/): Plan and schedule social content from within Canva.
- [Real-time collaboration](https://www.canva.com/features/real-time-collaboration/): Work together on designs simultaneously with comments and edits.

## Education, Nonprofits, and Specialized Solutions
- [Canva for Education](https://www.canva.com/education/): Free and classroom-focused design tools for teachers and students.
- [Canva for Nonprofits](https://www.canva.com/canva-for-nonprofits/): Discounted or free access for eligible nonprofit organizations.
- [Canva for Teachers](https://www.canva.com/education/teachers/): Teaching resources and classroom workflows for educators using Canva.
- [Canva for Students](https://www.canva.com/education/students/): Student-focused design and collaboration tools for schoolwork and projects.
- [Canva for Small Business](https://www.canva.com/small-business/): Marketing and design workflows tailored to small business teams.
- [Canva for Creators](https://www.canva.com/creators/): Programs and opportunities for template designers and contributors.

## Developer Platform
- [Canva Developers](https://www.canva.dev/): Developer portal for building apps and integrations for Canva.
- [Developer docs](https://www.canva.dev/docs/): Technical documentation for Canva apps, APIs, and platform capabilities.
- [API reference](https://www.canva.dev/docs/api-reference/): Reference documentation for Canva developer APIs and endpoints.
- [Apps SDK](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/): Build embedded Canva apps with the platform SDK and app APIs.
- [Connect APIs](https://www.canva.dev/docs/connect/): APIs for integrating Canva with external products and workflows.
- [Developer guides](https://www.canva.dev/docs/guides/): Step-by-step implementation guides for common Canva integrations.
- [Developer changelog](https://www.canva.dev/docs/changelog/): Track updates and changes to Canva’s developer platform.

- [Design School tutorials](https://www.canva.com/designschool/tutorials/): Practical how-to tutorials for creating designs in Canva.
- [Design School blog](https://www.canva.com/designschool/blog/): Articles on design principles, communication, and creative best practices.
- [Canva Learn](https://www.canva.com/learn/): Educational content covering design, marketing, and storytelling topics.
